newsitem.title: USA: Walgreen on track for 230 new stores in FY97.
newsitem.headline: Walgreen on track for 230 new stores in FY97.

text.p: Walgreen Co said Monday it was on track to open 230 new stores during this fiscal year.
During the first six months of fiscal 1997, Walgreen opened 102 new drugstores, of which 30 were relocations.
As of February 28, the close of its fiscal second quarter, Walgreen operated 2,256 drugstores in 34 states and Puerto Rico, versus 2,131 a year ago.
Earlier, Walgreen reported earnings for the second quarter that were up 16.3 percent to $147 million or $0.59 a sahre. Sales for the quarter rose 13.3 percent to $3.60 billion.

Chairman Charles Walgreen III said the strong net earnings were aided by good expense controls, an excellent Christmas selling season and strong pharmacy sales, which advanced 17.5 percent for the quarter as well as for the six months.
Same store pharmacy sales were up 12.2 percent for the quarter and 11.8 percent for the first six months. Total comparable store sales rose eight percent for both the quarter and the six months.

"Our prescription business now accounts for more than 45 percent of our total sales," Walgreen said in a statement. "We project this business to get even stronger in the future as the baby boomers age and as more and more people find themselves in managed care."

L. Daniel Jorndt, president, said the company continues to aggressively expand in existing markets and move into new markets as well. "Our newest markets, Dallas and Las Vegas, are exceeding expectations," Jorndt sid.
"Our more established new markets -- including Indianapolis, Cleveland and Buffalo -- are leading the company in comparable store sales gains," Jorndt added.
He said new Walgreen stores will open for the first time this summer in Kansas City and Detroit.
